system.name: LoongServe
system.one_liner: an LLM serving system using elastic sequence parallelism to adapt parallelism degree to variable-length requests and phases

components.name: SIB
components.role: scaling information base; supplies profiling results used by the global manager

components.name: LoongServe Global Manager
components.role: manages requests, elastic instances and the unified KV cache pool with a global view

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: schedules batches/parallelism configuration for elastic instances

components.name: Elasticity Controller
components.role: controls scaling of elastic instances up and down

components.name: GPU
components.role: physical device backing each elastic instance

components.name: Unified Distributed KV Cache Pool
components.role: GPU memory pool storing key-value tensors at token granularity across elastic instances to reduce fragmentation (§4)

content.key_idea: a global manager, informed by a scaling information base, dispatches and schedules requests and elastically scales GPU-backed instances up or down, all sharing one unified distributed key-value cache pool.
content.reading_order: top-down: SIB feeds the LoongServe Global Manager (Dispatcher, Scheduler, Elasticity Controller) at top, which drives scale up/down actions on the row of GPUs, all sitting above the shared KV cache pool at the bottom.

encoding.color_means: pastel colors distinguish the manager's three sub-components (Dispatcher, Scheduler, Elasticity Controller) and separate scale-up (left, orange-tinted) from scale-down (right, green-tinted) actions
encoding.line_style_means: dashed horizontal divider separates the control-plane (Global Manager) from the data-plane (GPU instances and KV cache)

summary: This figure gives the system overview of LoongServe, an elastic LLM serving system. At the top, the LoongServe Global Manager, informed by a Scaling Information Base (SIB), contains a Dispatcher, Scheduler, and Elasticity Controller that jointly manage requests and elastic instances with a global view. Below a dashed divider, this control plane drives LoongServe Scale Up and LoongServe Scale Down actions over a row of GPU-backed elastic instances, all of which share a Unified Distributed KV Cache Pool spanning all instances at token granularity to reduce memory fragmentation. The diagram is a compact top-down layered architecture using pastel flat-filled boxes for the manager's sub-components, a database icon for the SIB, GPU chip icons in a row, and a colored band at the bottom for the shared cache pool, visually separating control-plane decision-making from the elastic data-plane resources it manages.
summary_zh: 该图展示LoongServe系统总体架构：顶部LoongServe全局管理器（含Dispatcher、Scheduler、Elasticity Controller）依据SIB的画像信息进行请求与弹性实例的全局管理，驱动下方GPU实例的弹性扩容(Scale Up)与缩容(Scale Down)，所有实例共享底部统一分布式KV缓存池以减少显存碎片。
